verdict.rationale: Mastra's private model gateways let teams self-host models and block external providers. This keeps sensitive data from reaching third-party models that could train on it, so the training outcome is achieved only indirectly through data isolation. The evidence never mentions model training. missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-usage policy for Mastra Cloud and the framework, a documented training opt-out for routed third-party providers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Self-hosting removes the third party, preventing sensitive data from reaching models outside of your network.
set `AUTO_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS=true` in your `.env` so users can only select models from your own gateways.
